# technitium_dhcp_scope (Resource)

Manages a DHCP scope. Reserved leases are `technitium_dhcp_reserved_lease` resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# With dns_updates the server creates the zones leases need when missing,
# so create them before the scope.
resource "technitium_zone" "home" {
  zone = "home.example.com"
}

resource "technitium_zone" "home_reverse" {
  zone = "1.168.192.in-addr.arpa"
}

resource "technitium_dhcp_scope" "lan" {
  name                = "lan"
  starting_address    = "192.168.1.100"
  ending_address      = "192.168.1.250"
  subnet_mask         = "255.255.255.0"
  router_address      = "192.168.1.1"
  use_this_dns_server = true
  domain_name         = technitium_zone.home.zone
  dns_updates         = true

  exclusions = [{
    starting_address = "192.168.1.100"
    ending_address   = "192.168.1.109"
  }]

  depends_on = [technitium_zone.home_reverse]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ending_address` (String) The last IP address the scope hands out.
- `name` (String) The scope name. Changing it replaces the scope. Deleting the scope drops its reserved leases and deletes the DNS records of its dynamic leases; the records of reserved leases with a `host_name` stay.
- `starting_address` (String) The first IP address the scope hands out.
- `subnet_mask` (String) The subnet mask of the network, for example `255.255.255.0`.

### Optional

- `allow_only_reserved_leases` (Boolean) Hand out reserved leases only, no dynamic addresses.
- `block_locally_administered_mac_addresses` (Boolean) Give no dynamic address to clients with a locally administered (randomized) MAC address.
- `boot_file_name` (String) The boot file on the TFTP server (file, option 67).
- `capwap_ac_ip_addresses` (List of String) The CAPWAP access controller addresses wireless access points connect to (option 138).
- `dns_overwrite_for_dynamic_lease` (Boolean) Overwrite an existing `A` record with a client's name for dynamic leases.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) The DNS server addresses clients use (option 6). Ignored when `use_this_dns_server` is `true`.
- `dns_ttl` (Number) The TTL of the DNS records added for clients.
- `dns_updates` (Boolean) Add and remove forward and reverse DNS records for clients in `domain_name`. A reserved lease replaces every `A` record at its name and `PTR` record at its reverse name, and so does a dynamic lease with `dns_overwrite_for_dynamic_lease`; removing the lease deletes its records. Don't manage records at DHCP host names with `technitium_record_*`.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain name of the network (option 15). With `dns_updates`, clients get forward and reverse DNS records in it. The server creates a primary zone for this domain, and one for the scope's reverse network, when no zone holds them, so a later `technitium_zone` for them fails with "already exists". Create those zones first: set this to the `technitium_zone`'s `zone` and add the reverse zone to `depends_on`.
- `domain_search_list` (List of String) The domain names clients append when resolving short names (option 119).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the scope hands out addresses. Technitium enables a new scope; it serves only on a network interface in the scope's subnet. Disabling it deletes the DNS records of its dynamic leases and enabling it adds them back; the records of reserved leases stay.
- `exclusions` (Attributes Set) Address ranges in the scope that are never handed out dynamically. An empty set removes them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclusions))
- `generic_options` (Attributes Set) DHCP options without an attribute of their own. An empty set removes them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--generic_options))
- `ignore_client_identifier_option` (Boolean) Identify clients by MAC address only, ignoring the client identifier (option 61) they send. Changing it may give existing clients another address on renewal.
- `lease_time_days` (Number) The days part of the lease time. Technitium's default is `7`.
- `lease_time_hours` (Number) The hours part of the lease time.
- `lease_time_minutes` (Number) The minutes part of the lease time.
- `ntp_server_domain_names` (List of String) NTP server names, such as `pool.ntp.org`, that the server resolves and adds to the NTP servers clients get (option 42).
- `ntp_servers` (List of String) The NTP server addresses clients use (option 42).
- `offer_delay_time` (Number) The milliseconds to wait before sending an offer, so another DHCP server on the network can answer first.
- `ping_check_enabled` (Boolean) Ping an address before handing it out, to avoid conflicts with devices configured by hand.
- `ping_check_retries` (Number) The number of pings to try.
- `ping_check_timeout` (Number) The milliseconds to wait for a ping reply.
- `router_address` (String) The default gateway clients use (option 3).
- `server_address` (String) The address of the next (TFTP) server clients boot from (siaddr). Defaults to the DHCP server's own address.
- `server_host_name` (String) The host name of the TFTP boot server (sname, option 66).
- `static_routes` (Attributes Set) Routes clients use to reach other networks (option 121). An empty set removes them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--static_routes))
- `tftp_server_addresses` (List of String) The TFTP or VoIP configuration server addresses (option 150).
- `use_this_dns_server` (Boolean) Give clients this DNS server's address as their DNS server, instead of `dns_servers`.
- `vendor_info` (Attributes Set) Vendor specific information (option 43) for clients of a vendor class. An empty set removes it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vendor_info))
- `wins_servers` (List of String) The NetBIOS name server (WINS) addresses clients use (option 44).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

Required:

### Nested Schema for `generic_options`

Required:

- `code` (Number) The DHCP option code.
- `value` (String) The option value, as upper case hex bytes separated by colons, for example `C0:A8:01:01`.

### Nested Schema for `static_routes`

Required:

- `destination` (String) The destination network address.
- `router` (String) The gateway for the destination.
- `subnet_mask` (String) The destination subnet mask.

### Nested Schema for `vendor_info`

Required:

- `identifier` (String) The vendor class identifier, or an expression on it such as `substring(vendor-class-identifier,0,9)=="PXEClient"`.
- `information` (String) The vendor specific information, as upper case hex bytes separated by colons, for example `06:01:03`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import technitium_dhcp_scope.lan lan
```
